articles.summary: Citius Oncology, Inc. ("Citius Oncology" or the "Company") (Nasdaq: CTOR) today announced health-related quality of life (HRQoL) results from pivotal Study 302 ( NCT01871727 ) of LYMPHIR® (denileukin diftitox-cxdl) in adults with relapsed or refractory (r/r) cutaneous T-cell lymphoma (CTCL). Christiane Querfeld, MD, PhD, of City of Hope, delivered an oral presentation at the European Organisation for Research and Treatment of Cancer Cutaneous Lymphoma Tumour Group (EORTC-CLTG) 2026 Annual Meeting, held October 8–10, 2026, in Berlin, Germany. "Patients and physicians have told us that both clinical response and quality of life matter in CTCL treatment," said Leonard Mazur, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Citius Oncology. "These data add the patient's voice to the efficacy and durability shown in our pivotal trial. We were pleased to share the data at the EORTC-CLTG conference in Berlin and are proud to partner with the Cutaneous Lymphoma Foundation on its November 2026 workshop
articles.title: Citius Oncology's Positive Quality of Life Data for LYMPHIR® (denileukin diftitox-cxdl) in Relapsed or Refractory Cutaneous T-Cell Lymphoma Presented at Premier Global CLTG Congress in Europe
